text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing the day's training—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today, Trainer.
Thank you for guiding me once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following Satono Diamond's gaze... I saw Kitasan Black diligently training.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Not yet! One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, excuse me. If it's alright,
would it be okay if I did some extra training after all?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I was just watching
footage of Kita-chan's race yesterday, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan's running right now...
it's definitely gotten faster and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I do feel impatient, but more than that……
I'm itching so badly to run, I can hardly stand it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A fire has been lit in my heart!
So... please!
choice_data_list: Let's save that fire for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A fire has been lit in my heart!
So... please!
choice_data_list: Let's save that fire for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Well then, I'll go run too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Kita-chan. I... won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, burning with passion for her rival,
Satono Diamond completed her self-directed training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I have to wait until tomorrow...?
Ugh, I'm not sure I can hold out that long...!"
choice_data_list: Hold it in, hold it in, and let your feelings explode!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. That's a promise, okay?
That tomorrow, you'll let me train with everything I've got...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...That's right! In that case, let's go
watch the footage together in the trainer's office right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, this itch will build up
even moooore, and I feel like
I'll be able to give it my all tomorrow!"
choice_data_list: Shall we watch it together, then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we watched races centered around Kitasan Black,
accompanied by enthusiastic commentary
from Satono Diamond.
